root_idea.summary: The root is centered on sheep, especially wool-bearing sheep as a livestock category, with related Classical expressions concerning sheep and their distinguishing characteristics.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from the sheep designation to setting sheep apart from goats, having a numerous flock, sheep-related adjectives, and established figurative descriptions of softness or laxness.

senses.definition: Sheep, the wool-bearing kind of livestock.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective or quasi-plural noun for sheep of the class called غنم, contrasted with goats; in the Quranic occurrence it appears in the construction “of sheep, two.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set apart sheep from goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verb used in expressions distinguishing sheep from goats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have a numerous flock of sheep; for one's sheep to become numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a man or a group of men in relation to their sheep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for certain species of lizards and of jerboas.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These zoological uses distinguish the named species from corresponding ماعز kinds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel nose-ring made of sinew.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A ring of the type used through a camel’s nose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to sheep; applied to goats that keep to sheep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exceptional or distorted relative adjective, used in the expression for goats that associate with sheep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broad or large sheep-hide skin used as a vessel for churning cultured milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a skin vessel made from a sheep’s hide, especially in the expression سِقَاءٌ ضِئْنِيٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wool-bearing sheep; used adjectivally as an epithet of a ram.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The individual counterpart to ضَأْنٌ and an adjective describing a sheep or ram as wool-bearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, weak or soft; of a person, soft-bodied, or of the belly, soft and flaccid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use applied to a man or to bodily softness and laxness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: White and broad, said of sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, figurative or assumed-figurative description of sand.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to the preceding entry.

cautions: The public headword ضَأْنٌ is normalized from the inflected Quranic form and QAC lemma display candidate.

The Quranic noun is attested once; the derived verbs, relative adjective, zoological uses, and figurative extensions are kept under broader Classical meanings rather than assigned to the Quranic occurrence.
